SELECT CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS average_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries

WITH batter_runs AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
)
SELECT
  batter,
  ROUND(100.0 * boundary_runs / total_runs, 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM batter_runs
ORDER BY 1.0 * boundary_runs / total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT batter
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
)

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(extras_type, '')) NOT IN ('wide', 'wides', 'noball', 'noballs', 'no-ball', 'no-balls')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type != 'wide' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING runs >= 300 AND legal_balls > 0
)
SELECT 
  batter,
  ROUND(CAST(runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / legal_balls, 2) AS strike_rate
FROM batter_stats
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, 
       (SUM(batsman_runs) + SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'no_balls', 'noballs', 'wide', 'no ball') THEN extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'no_balls', 'noballs', 'wide', 'no ball') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS economy
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'no_balls', 'noballs', 'wide', 'no ball') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler,
       CAST(SUM(batsman_runs + extra_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(is_wicket) AS bowling_average
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(is_wicket) >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH season_team_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    m.season,
    d.batting_team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
  FROM deliveries d
  JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
  GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    batting_team,
    runs,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY runs DESC) AS rnk
  FROM season_team_runs
)
SELECT season, batting_team AS team, runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY season

SELECT winner, target_runs
FROM matches
WHERE target_runs IS NOT NULL
  AND result = 'wickets'
ORDER BY target_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH team_matches AS (
  SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
  FROM (
    SELECT team1 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
  )
  GROUP BY team
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
),
team_wins AS (
  SELECT winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM matches
  WHERE season = '2023' AND winner IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY winner
)
SELECT tm.team, 
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(tw.wins, 0) / tm.matches_played, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM team_matches tm
LEFT JOIN team_wins tw ON tm.team = tw.team
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1
